title: Earth Orbit
body:
Low orbit above Earth: a blue marble fills the lower viewscreen, white cloud swirls over ocean and continent, the black of space above cut by a thin glowing blue line of atmosphere, and the Sun, when it rises over the limb, flares hard and white with no air to soften it.

Travel facts for this destination: distance 420 km; one-way light-time 1.401 milliseconds; at one tenth of light speed the crossing takes 14.010 milliseconds. The verbal viewscreen above describes what the viewer sees on arrival, in words, as the simulator's screen would show it.

Standard math: light speed c = 299,792,458 m/s is the absolute limit; no faster-than-light travel is offered as working physics. Light-time delay for this destination is 1.401 milliseconds, and at 0.1c the crossing takes 14.010 milliseconds with time dilation factor 1.0050, so the traveler's clock runs slower than stay-at-home clocks by that factor.
